title: What Is the Holy Ghost?
collection: The Truth Shall Make You Free · Kente FM Radio
summary: The Truth Shall Make You Free · Kente FM Radio · 2017-08-14
body:
The Truth Shall Make You Free · Kente FM Radio · 2017-08-14 · Bishop Nathanyel

Opens [Acts 19](/bible/acts/19) · [Ps 51](/bible/psalms/51) · [Acts 7](/bible/acts/7) · [John 20](/bible/john/20) · [Acts 1](/bible/acts/1) · [John 14](/bible/john/14) · [Prov 1](/bible/proverbs/1) · [John 3](/bible/john/3) · [Eph 4](/bible/ephesians/4) · [Matt 3](/bible/matthew/3) · [Isa 66](/bible/isaiah/66) · [Acts 21](/bible/acts/21) · [2 Kgs 2](/bible/2-kings/2) · [Num 11](/bible/numbers/11) · [Joel 2](/bible/joel/2) · [Acts 2](/bible/acts/2) · and 5 more below
## Introduction *[[0:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=7s)]* The baptism and the receiving of the Holy Ghost. The Holy Ghost makes two references: one is spiritual understanding of the law and the scriptures, the other is spiritual power; the stipulation for receiving it is keeping God's commandments, it was poured upon Israelites only, and it is given by measure. ## Scriptures Opened **[Acts 19:1-6](/bible/acts/19#v1)** *[[1:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=65s)]* > [1](/bible/acts/19#v1) And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples, > > [2](/bible/acts/19#v2) He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost. > > [3](/bible/acts/19#v3) And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John’s baptism. > > [4](/bible/acts/19#v4) Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus. > > [5](/bible/acts/19#v5) When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus. > > [6](/bible/acts/19#v6) And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied. - **Host:** This show is dedicated to the saints in the diaspora, to discuss the twelve tribes of Israel, to wake up the tribes and assure them that a kingdom is there waiting for them only if we repent. Expound for us the baptism and the receiving of the Holy Ghost, what it actually means. - **Host:** So that is the Holy Ghost there referring to power: speaking in other languages, prophesying in the name of the Lord. That's what it said: Holy Ghost, tongues and prophesied. - I want to take us from beginning to end about the Holy Ghost. I first want you to notice where it says, we have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost. - The Holy Ghost he's making reference to is the power that Joel was talking about. **[Psalms 51:11](/bible/psalms/51#v11)** *[[4:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=298s)]* > [11](/bible/psalms/51#v11) Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me. - I want you to notice that in Psalm 51 David mentions the Holy Ghost, in fact in a different context. - Notice he uses the word spirit. The word spirit and ghost is the same word in the Hebrew, …, which means spirit or ghost. So even during the time of David the Spirit was there. - I'm going to show you other scriptures where God had the Holy Ghost upon people like Moses and Elijah. - The Holy Ghost makes two references: one can be power, which is the one shown in Acts 19; the other can be a spiritual understanding of the scriptures, of the law. I want to start there. **[Acts 7:51-53](/bible/acts/7#v51)** *[[6:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=388s)]* > [51](/bible/acts/7#v51) Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye. > > [52](/bible/acts/7#v52) Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers: > > [53](/bible/acts/7#v53) Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it. - Stephen was telling the Pharisees, you always resist the Holy Ghost. We want to find out: is he talking about spiritual power or the law? - So what is the Holy Ghost they resisted? Is that the law? Yes. In one context the Holy Ghost can be talking about the law; that is what is talking about here. - This is what most people don't understand. They hear Holy Ghost and automatically jump to power, but that's not the only reference. **[John 20:22-23](/bible/john/20#v22)** *[[8:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=517s)]* > [22](/bible/john/20#v22) And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost: > > [23](/bible/john/20#v23) Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained. - What I want you to see is Christ breathed on them and said, receive ye the Holy Ghost. So they received the Holy Ghost there. **[Acts 1:4-5](/bible/acts/1#v4)** *[[9:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=560s)]* > [4](/bible/acts/1#v4) And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me. > > [5](/bible/acts/1#v5) For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence. - He says ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence, but they already received the Holy Ghost in John 20: he breathed on them. - These are the different uses of the term Holy Ghost. One can be an understanding of the law, the other is power. **[Acts 1:7-8](/bible/acts/1#v7)** *[[10:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=604s)]* > [7](/bible/acts/1#v7) And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power. > > [8](/bible/acts/1#v8) But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. - Now let's go to the power. You see he says you shall receive power after the Holy Ghost is come upon you. - Remember in John 20 they already got the Holy Ghost. So we're talking about two different things. - Many people say they have the Holy Ghost, but the only context they're using is power, people always falling down. That's not what the Bible is talking about at all. **[John 14:15-16,26](/bible/john/14#v15)** *[[11:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=669s)]* > [15](/bible/john/14#v15) If ye love me, keep my commandments. > > [16](/bible/john/14#v16) And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; > > [26](/bible/john/14#v26) But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you. - The stipulation for receiving the Holy Ghost is keeping God's commandments. None of these churches today keeps the commandments, but they all got the Holy Ghost? That makes no sense. - I could sell drugs or smoke drugs and get the Holy Ghost? It's impossible. You must be keeping the commandments in order to have the Holy Ghost in you. - The Holy Ghost is that spirit of understanding. He shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance. - When you ask these people who claim to have the Holy Ghost who they are in the Bible, because the Bible names all races, they go, I don't know. So then you don't have the Holy Ghost. - The Holy Ghost will bring the understanding that we are Israel. These people in these churches don't have that spirit of understanding; they've just got lip service. **[Proverbs 1:23](/bible/proverbs/1#v23)** *[[14:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=886s)]* > [23](/bible/proverbs/1#v23) Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you. - Christ said if you love me, keep my commandments, and I will pray the Father and he shall give you another comforter, which is the Holy Ghost. So the stipulation for receiving the Holy Ghost was keeping the law. Let's see if Proverbs is different. - Turn you at my reproof: that's the same thing as John 14. When he sees you walk in his law, then and only then will he pour out his spirit on you. - I will make known my words unto you: that's the same thing Christ said in John 14:26, he shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance. It's saying the same thing, nothing different. - **Host:** The reason I am much more concerned about the power: when the Christians do the crusade, people come forward, they lay hands and people start falling down. When you speak against those things they tell you that you are not in the spirit. That is why I am seeking clarification. - When Christ breathed on the disciples they got understanding of the scriptures, like we read in John. These Christian churches, he's breathing on them and they're all falling down. I see the videos, thousands of people falling. There's no scripture to do that. **[John 3:34](/bible/john/3#v34)** *[[18:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1086s)]* > [34](/bible/john/3#v34) For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him. - Now let's look at the power. Christ did not have a measure of the Spirit; he had the full package. - He had spiritual understanding and spiritual power. He had the full measure. **[Ephesians 4:7](/bible/ephesians/4#v7)** *[[18:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1120s)]* > [7](/bible/ephesians/4#v7) But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ. - Let's see what it says about men. We have been given a measure; when you compare that to Christ, he was without measure. - We as men have measures. That's why in another parable Christ gave … to one he gave five, to another he gave one. - So depending upon the man or the woman, we are given the spirit by measure. **[Matthew 3:11-12](/bible/matthew/3#v11)** *[[19:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1163s)]* > [11](/bible/matthew/3#v11) I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire: > > [12](/bible/matthew/3#v12) Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire. - The fire being mentioned is the nuclear destruction that is going to come upon the earth. That is what that's talking about. - Sometimes I've heard Christians translate the fire as in Acts, the Holy Spirit looking like cloven tongues of fire on their heads. That's not what Matthew 3 is talking about. - John is explaining the fire that Christ is going to bring is destruction. The fire he is talking about is a thermonuclear destruction; that's why it says the fire is unquenchable fire. **[Isaiah 66:15-17](/bible/isaiah/66#v15)** *[[21:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1279s)]* > [15](/bible/isaiah/66#v15) For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire. > > [16](/bible/isaiah/66#v16) For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many. > > [17](/bible/isaiah/66#v17) They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord. - This is just for the fire part. By fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh, and the slain of the Lord shall be many. - It's going to kill those people that eat swine's flesh and the mouse; any animal in the mouse family, the abomination, abominable food. - The history is that there was a custom: in your yard you would cut down a tree and carve the stump into whatever god you worship. That's why it says purify themselves in the gardens. Around that god you would eat swine's flesh, the abomination and the mouse. - What do we call that today? Churches. That's the garden it's talking about. Pentecostal is one garden, … is another, Seventh-day Adventist is another, Jehovah's Witness is another. - They sanctify themselves and purify themselves because they use the Bible, but they're worshipping a false god. Today it is the white image of Jesus. - I remember at church after Sunday school we would have a food sale, collard greens and …, and everything had pork in it. That's what verse 17 is talking about. **[Matthew 3:11](/bible/matthew/3#v11)** *[[25:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1506s)]* > [11](/bible/matthew/3#v11) I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire: - Now back to Matthew 3:11 to get a better understanding of what John was talking about. The Holy Ghost John was making reference to is the power we read in Acts 1. - It is also, which everyone ignores, a spiritual understanding of scripture. In John 20 when Christ breathed on the disciples and said receive ye the Holy Ghost, they received a spiritual understanding of scripture. - Then in Acts 1 he said wait until you are endowed with power from the Holy Ghost. That's when it came down like a rushing wind and they began to speak in tongues and prophesied, which was prophetic of Joel 2. - Always remember the stipulation for the Holy Ghost is keeping God's commandments. These people today claiming it, Jimmy Swaggart, Kenneth Copeland, none of them have the Holy Ghost. None of them. - **Host:** In the time of the apostles, when they baptized they laid their hands on them so that they received the Holy Ghost. Did all of them also have the power to heal? **[Acts 19:11-12](/bible/acts/19#v11)** *[[27:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1633s)]* > [11](/bible/acts/19#v11) And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul: > > [12](/bible/acts/19#v12) So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them. - God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul. - What I want all the listeners to understand: everyone that received the Holy Ghost with power did not have the same measure. - Remember Ephesians 4: we as men were given the spirit by measure, but Christ had it without measure. The power Paul had, everyone that got the Holy Ghost did not have that power. **[Acts 21:8-9](/bible/acts/21#v8)** *[[28:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1689s)]* > [8](/bible/acts/21#v8) And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Cesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him. > > [9](/bible/acts/21#v9) And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy. - Philip had four daughters which did prophesy, but they did not have the measure that Paul had. - You don't even read about that with the other twelve; Peter, though, had a great measure of the spirit on him. - Christ did not have the spirit by measure; he was without measure. Paul had a measure of the spirit of power greater than many of the other disciples. This is what Christians don't understand. Precepts: - **[John 3:34](/bible/john/3#v34)** > [34](/bible/john/3#v34) For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him. For God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him: Christ did not have it by measure. **[2 Kings 2:9](/bible/2-kings/2#v9)** *[[30:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1823s)]* > [9](/bible/2-kings/2#v9) And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me. - Let me show you the same power in the Old Testament. The spirit he was talking about was power, because Elijah had spiritual power. - Elisha said, I want a double portion of that spirit you got. - So the power that Christ gave the disciples was not new on earth. This is what I want people to see, because they think it was a new thing in the earth. It was not. **[Numbers 11:25](/bible/numbers/11#v25)** *[[31:39](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1899s)]* > [25](/bible/numbers/11#v25) And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease. - God took of the spirit from Moses: I will take some of that spirit and put it on the seventy elders. - The spirit of power that the disciples received was not new in the earth; it had been with the Israelites for a long time. - Not every dispensation had the power. During the time of Jeremiah, Jeremiah did not have that spirit in the context of power; he had the spirit in the context of understanding, but not spiritual power. … had the spirit of understanding but not power, and all those prophets. **[Joel 2:28-32](/bible/joel/2#v28)** *[[32:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=1956s)]* > [28](/bible/joel/2#v28) And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions: > > [29](/bible/joel/2#v29) And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit. > > [30](/bible/joel/2#v30) And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke. > > [31](/bible/joel/2#v31) The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the Lord come. > > [32](/bible/joel/2#v32) And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call. - This is the famous one. - This spirit was being poured upon Israelites only: in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call. The remnant is scattered Israel. - That's another stipulation. Other people think, I got the Holy Spirit. No, you don't. - Upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit. Let us not forget what Christ said in John 14:15: if you love me keep my commandments. Remember Proverbs 1:23: turn you at my reproof and I will pour out my spirit. It's the same thing. - There's no scripture where you can eat pork, swine's flesh, worship images and idols and get the Holy Ghost. There's no scripture where other races got the Holy Ghost. Even Cornelius of the Italian band was Israel. **[Acts 2:16-18](/bible/acts/2#v16)** *[[36:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2175s)]* > [16](/bible/acts/2#v16) But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel; > > [17](/bible/acts/2#v17) And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams: > > [18](/bible/acts/2#v18) And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy: - In Acts 2 there is no mention of the miracles Paul was doing; the only thing mentioned is speaking and prophesying. - Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your young men shall see visions, your old men shall dream dreams. It's being very specific there. - People read that and say, I'll lay hands on you and heal you. No, you're not doing that today. That measure is not given to us today. - What we're reading about is talking about these last days: seeing visions, dreaming dreams and prophesying. Many people don't even understand what it means to prophesy. **[Revelation 19:10](/bible/revelation/19#v10)** *[[38:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2300s)]* > [10](/bible/revelation/19#v10) And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy. - When you testify of Christ, that is the spirit of prophecy. - When these Christians prophesy about Christ, they are prophesying about the image of the white man coming to save the world. There is nothing to that. They don't have the Holy Ghost; they don't have the understanding. - Everybody is concentrated on the power to heal, and the power they have is fictitious. How come these ministers don't walk into the hospitals? - You've got to go to their place and give them money before a healing. That is not scripture. Unless you give them money, they don't heal none of that. It is total madness. - **Host:** Sometimes people say, we are concentrating on the teachings of the scripture, but people are suffering, people are sick. How come those people are healed if you just read the Bible and give meanings to prophecies? **[John 5:6-9,14](/bible/john/5#v6)** *[[41:32](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2492s)]* > [6](/bible/john/5#v6) When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole? > > [7](/bible/john/5#v7) The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me. > > [8](/bible/john/5#v8) Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk. > > [9](/bible/john/5#v9) And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath. > > [14](/bible/john/5#v14) Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee. - I'm going to show you a popular healing. This impotent man wanted to get into this pool where an angel came down to trouble the water to heal, but every time he was about to go, somebody got to the pool before him. Christ said take up your bed and walk, and Christ healed the man. - Watch what he says in verse 14 to the same man: sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon thee. Why would this man be impotent? Because of sin, by breaking the commandments. - How come these ministers don't give that message to these people? I'll heal you, I'll heal you, but they're all eating pork, they're all committing adultery, they're all going to idols. This is such malarkey; this is just foolishness in the world today. - Christ said sin no more, meaning he had broken God's laws. You never hear that mentioned in church. So they're not the ministers of the Lord. - **Host:** When some people ask me questions they say, I just want you to tell me, not go into the scriptures. I tell them I am not in an examination room giving you definitions. The Bible is not about definition, the Bible is about precept. I don't speak my mind; the Bible speaks for itself. **[Isaiah 8:20](/bible/isaiah/8#v20)** *[[45:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2720s)]* > [20](/bible/isaiah/8#v20) To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them. - These Christians you're talking to, there is no light in them. They don't want to speak according to the word. **[Isaiah 65:2](/bible/isaiah/65#v2)** *[[45:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2749s)]* > [2](/bible/isaiah/65#v2) I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts; - The people you're talking to walk after their own thoughts. They don't want to hear what the Bible says. - That's how you know they're not the disciples of the Lord. They are not the servants of the Lord at all. **[1 Corinthians 13:8](/bible/1-corinthians/13#v8)** *[[47:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2825s)]* > [8](/bible/1-corinthians/13#v8) Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away. - Paul is letting us know charity, which is loving your neighbour, shall never fail, never stop. But whether there be prophecies, they shall fail: many prophecies will be fulfilled and end. - Whether there be tongues, they shall cease. He's letting you know speaking in tongues, the actual gift that the apostles got in Acts 1, is dispensational; it is not always. - Whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away. The knowledge that we have is temporary until the Lord returns. - One minister told me we had the Holy Ghost even when we was on slave ships, we was prophesying, we was healing. I said that's a lie. When Peter was in jail the angel came and released him. How come the angels didn't come and release us from the shackles if we had the Holy Ghost? I told the minister, stop the lies. - Paul says speaking in tongues will cease. How come ministers don't teach that? Because it's not lucrative for their money. ## In Closing *[[49:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U&t=2950s)]* First Corinthians 13 lets you know speaking in tongues will cease. How come ministers don't teach that? Because it's not lucrative for their money. ## Announcements & References - Subscribe and join the channel. --- [Class Notes Index](/classes) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p__ZvntUM1U)
